recap.text: Orren brings Carl and Donut to the Desperado Club to account for the death of Loita. Orren cannot establish intent and releases them with a note in the file. Carl declines a Legendary box in exchange for the name of his source. No third party may teleport a crawler out until the next floor, and Carl's appearance on Odette's program is cancelled.

Orren delivers a request from Borant for Carl to surrender the Gate of the Feral Gods until the ninth floor. Carl asks for a lawyer. Orren explains that liaisons are chosen for their passion for the game and disagreement with their own nation. Orren brings Quasar and a woman in a Goddamnit, Donut shirt to Carl because the courts have frozen crawl-related cases.

Orren stands beside Showrunner Cascadia and explains that the system AI took operations from the showrunners. He reports a settlement where the AI returns most controls for concessions, but the boss it built alone remains. Orren tells Crawler Carl in the Desperado Club that the Open Intellect Pacifist Network set a trap. The AI is removing protections for the remaining Residuals.

Orren hangs up on the prime minister of the Syndicate. He twists his ball to open a zero zone ten minutes outside the AI's influence and mutes the creatures that appear. Orren asks Carl if he broke the AI from its containment deliberately, but Carl does not answer. Orren tells them not to discuss the conversation outside the room.

Crawler Carl trades questions with the Caprids and tells the Prime Minister and Orren on an open channel what Justice Light's trap did to the Nothing. The AI locks Orren out, stating it is being Hunted and only the AI is allowed to kill it. Orren passes a request for a diagnosis of the NPC Grigori and a debrief of Chaco.

beats.headline: He cannot prove it was on purpose
beats.text: Crawler Carl and Crawler Princess Donut have been brought before me at the Desperado Club to account for the death of Loita. My position is that it was deliberate. My position is not evidence. I cannot establish intent, and so I am required to release them, which I am doing, with a note in the file. They have only now worked out how long they have been outside the dungeon. Five days. Their faces are the one part of this I have enjoyed.
beats.gist: Orren releases Carl and Donut from the Desperado Club because he cannot prove Loita's death was deliberate.

beats.headline: Fifteen this season
beats.text: Not counting Administrator Loita, fifteen admins have died to crawlers this season. Crawler Lucia Mar accounts for two, three if one counts her first game guide, which we do not; she signed a confession both times. For every one of them we know exactly how it was done. For this one I can describe a mechanism and cannot establish that it was intended. I offered Crawler Carl a Legendary box for the name of his source. He declined. Until the next floor, no crawler will be teleported out by third parties, and Crawler Carl's next appearance on Odette's program is cancelled. My personal recommendation was not followed.
beats.gist: Orren tells Carl fifteen admins died to crawlers this season, excluding Administrator Loita.

beats.headline: Borant would like the Gate back
beats.text: The Hunting Grounds. I have been sent to Crawler Carl with a request from Borant, which I am instructed to describe as a request. They would like the Gate of the Feral Gods surrendered, voluntarily, to be held until the ninth floor and not a floor longer. I put it to him exactly as written. He asked for a lawyer. I have passed that back exactly as spoken. I expect to be sent again.
beats.gist: Orren tells Carl that Borant wants the Gate of the Feral Gods surrendered voluntarily.

beats.headline: A warning about liaisons
beats.text: I had Astrid bring Crawler Carl to me. I leave when this floor collapses and do not return until the ninth, so it is now. A liaison is chosen for two things: passion for the game, and fundamental disagreement with the goals of his own nation. Technically I should have lost this chair when the Valtay took control of Borant. I am not the only liaison who disagrees with his nation. Some of us meet that second requirement a little too much. I have said all I can about the matter.
beats.gist: Orren tells Carl that liaisons are chosen for passion and disagreement with their own nation.

beats.headline: The courts are frozen
beats.text: On to business. The courts have stopped nearly every crawl-related case, including ones the AI is usually indifferent to, until they have a better read on this AI's stability during the floor change. Crawler Carl's attorney now needs a court order to send him a message, and has not been permitted to try. We have decided to circumvent this, just this once, and I must remain in the room. I wave my hand, and Quasar is here, with a woman in a Goddamnit, Donut shirt.
beats.gist: Orren says the courts froze crawl-related cases, so he brings Quasar and a woman in a Donut shirt.

beats.headline: The system has taken the controls
beats.text: On air, beside Showrunner Cascadia, I explain what I am for. A liaison is a fact finder, and also the negotiator when the system AI takes operations from the showrunners. Today it did. I describe Primal Engines and the Macro AIs installed in them, simply. I report a settlement: the AI returns most of the seized controls in exchange for concessions, and will follow the rules. The boss it built alone remains in place. One of its demands was that the crawlers be told.
beats.gist: Orren explains that the system AI took operations from the showrunners and negotiated a settlement.

beats.headline: He calls it a trap
beats.text: I pull Crawler Carl into my old office in the Desperado Club and tell him what I can establish. The Residual had nothing of substance. The Open Intellect Pacifist Network, former crawlers who want the crawl to fail, set this up: either we yank him and anger the AI, or the speech is so dangerous that the Council pulls the failsafe and kills this system's star. I had pre-negotiated the pull. The AI is removing its protections for the remaining Residuals.
beats.gist: Orren pulls Carl into an office in the Desperado Club to discuss a trap.

beats.headline: Ten minutes outside the AI
beats.text: I have just hung up on the prime minister of the Syndicate. Crawler Carl told Crawler Princess Donut that Princess Formidable's actions will not work, and called it a hunch. We know about the illegal non-Valtay implant, when he got it, and his hidden conversation with the residual. We do not know what the implant does. So I twist my ball and open a zero zone: approximately ten minutes outside the AI's influence. Several creatures appear around us, shouting at me. I mute them. I believe I have just lost my job.
beats.gist: Orren opens a zero zone outside the AI's influence and mutes shouting creatures.

beats.headline: History will remember me
beats.text: I ask Crawler Carl whether he broke the AI from its containment, and whether he did it deliberately. He does not answer. Whether he did it on purpose is irrelevant now. History is going to remember me as the one who let this happen. When I left the Knot I said it was to make a difference. In truth, I wanted to be an actor, and to remain pure. I implore them both not to discuss this conversation outside the room.
beats.gist: Orren asks Carl if he deliberately broke the AI from its containment.

beats.headline: The trap that broke the Nothing
beats.text: Crawler Carl is among the Caprids, trading question for question, and one of the goats has just told him what Justice Light's trap did to the Nothing. The Prime Minister and I are on the line. We need him to ask a question about the integrity of the tunnelling system, and the reason we need it asked is not something I am cleared to say on an open channel. Crawler Carl has said it on an open channel. All of it. Live. I am going to be in meetings.
beats.gist: Carl trades questions with Caprids and reveals the tunnelling system reason on a live channel.

beats.headline: Locked out, and Hunted
beats.text: The Prime Minister would like a diagnosis pulled off the NPC Grigori, and Chaco brought in for a debrief. I remain locked out. The AI's stated reason is my own safety: I am being Hunted, it says, and only it is allowed to kill me. I will pass the request on. I note for the record that I cannot establish whether that is a threat or a protection.
beats.gist: The Prime Minister wants a diagnosis from Grigori and a debrief for Chaco.
